comment_mode: codec = H.264 compression (~1-4 Mbps), raw = uncompressed UDP (~20 Mbps)

video.comment_fps: Target frame rate (higher = smoother but more bandwidth)

encoding.comment_bitrate: 1M = 1 Mbps, 2M = 2 Mbps (higher = better quality, more bandwidth). At 60 FPS use 2M+
encoding.comment_gop: Keyframe interval in frames (should match fps for 1 second)
encoding.comment_low_latency: true = minimize buffering and latency (drops frames if needed), false = prioritize smooth playback
